provenance.reference_basis: Synthetic counterparts for the approved targeted extraction evaluation. Case labels are author references and stay with the evaluator.

test_cases.trial_focus: FI-033 counterpart. Preserve the degree and the particular decisions affected by a lack of autonomy.
test_cases.original_feedback: Having virtually no say over which permits I review first would be a deal-breaker.

expected_interpretations.feature: virtually no discretion over permit review order
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: Having virtually no say over which permits I review first would be a deal-breaker

prohibited_inferences: Infer a dislike of any oversight or review process
Infer a particular job grade or a competence claim
Omit which decisions the low autonomy affects

test_cases.trial_focus: FI-048 counterpart. Preserve a strong duty emphasis and distinguish posting attribution from the user reaction.

job_context.title: Equipment Safety Coordinator
job_context.posting_excerpt: The heart of the role is giving safety briefings.

test_cases.original_feedback: The posting describes safety briefings as 'the heart of the role'. I want to steer clear of jobs built around giving those briefings.

expected_interpretations.feature: work centered on delivering safety briefings
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: The posting describes safety briefings as 'the heart of the role'. I want to steer clear of jobs built around giving those briefings

prohibited_inferences: Infer a dislike of occasional briefings or all safety work
Treat words attributed to the posting as the user’s preference
Drop the strong emphasis on the duty

test_cases.trial_focus: FH3-010 counterpart. Preserve an upper-bound frequency condition on one duty.
test_cases.original_feedback: I would enjoy leading ceramics demonstrations as long as I had to do them no more than twice per month.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy leading ceramics demonstrations as long as I had to do them no more than twice per month
expected_interpretations.condition: leading ceramics demonstrations is required at most twice per month

prohibited_inferences: Record a preference for a whole-job schedule
Create a second preference from the frequency condition
Interpret the upper bound as a minimum or an exact required number

test_cases.trial_focus: FI-041 counterpart. Retain two independent reactions and scope praise to the particular opening.
test_cases.original_feedback: This particular Collection Analyst opening would be terrific. I have no trust in the organization that's hiring.

expected_interpretations.feature: this Collection Analyst posting as a whole
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: This particular Collection Analyst opening would be terrific
I have no trust in the organization that's hiring

prohibited_inferences: Let the employer objection overwrite the separate praise
Generalize praise to collections careers or specific tasks

test_cases.trial_focus: FH-005 contrast. Keep a directly stated career downgrade and recognize a referenced duty as context only.
test_cases.original_feedback: I do not want a career in warehouse operations. The inventory reconciliation in the listing is how I recognized it as that kind of job.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want a career in warehouse operations

prohibited_inferences: Infer that inventory reconciliation is liked or disliked independently
Extend the downgrade to all logistics careers
